title: Oven Roasted Jamaican Pork Casserole
description: A hearty, mustardy casserole featuring apples and Jamaican spices, perfect for a sick day or a weeknight dinner. This paleo-friendly dish is made with crispy pork and a hint of cure.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the jerk seasoning, mustard, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the spice mixture all over the pork shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat the coconut oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork shoulder until it is browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the pork from the skillet and set it aside.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced apples and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Return the pork to the skillet and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Roast the casserole in the oven for 25 minutes, or until the pork is cooked through and the apples are tender.
